answer: Re-attestations are stored in spiral and plume lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the beacon graph. Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 16 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 205 impostors cost 1629 times the honest price and take 28 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
